faq: Will a new listing improve my ranking?
We cannot promise ranking. Google Play ranks on many signals, including installs, ratings and retention. We make the page clear and accurate and follow policy, so visitors know what to expect.
What is the Data safety form?

It is a section of Play Console where you declare what data your app collects and shares. We compare your answers with what the app really does and flag mismatches, but you remain responsible for the final answers.

How do you speed up startup?

We profile cold start, then reduce work before the first screen appears, such as heavy initializers, large layouts or blocking calls. We aim for the biggest gains within the number of fixes in your package.
